newsitem.title: UK: Kewill Systems up on H1 profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Kewill Systems up on H1 profit growth.

text.p: Shares in UK software group Kewill Systems Plc rose sharply on Wednesday after the firm posted strong growth in first-half profit and earnings.
Kewill Systems shares were up 25p at 482-1/2, after the firm announced a 24 percent rise in pre-tax profit at 3.2 million stg in the six months ending September 30.

"The group has achieved strong growth," chairman Kevin Overstall said. "Overall, the directors consider that the group stands well placed to achieve further growth both organically and through strategic acquisitions."
Kewill's earnings per share rose 20 percent to 17.5p and the company raised its interim dividend 20 percent to 3.6p per share.
Overall said he expected the company's design software sales prospects to improve, while a joint marketing effort with IBM Corp would continue to produce increased sales.
Turnover rose 20 percent to 19.8 million stg, bolstered by 1.5 million stg sales from the firm's acquisitions.
